_note: Episode 9 (S2E1) version 3: 82 sentences, one picture per sentence (78 distinct frames on the sentences plus 4 montage extras k90-k93 = 82 key images; sentences 65, 66, 69 reuse an earlier key, never the one before). Gospel scene (sentences 25-46): Jesus only far or from behind, no face, no halo; disciples, the boy and the crowd generic. Indio, M and Usman at the edge, touching nothing. Lolo Pepe beat (sentences 9-17, Kawit prologue; and 71-75 in the fairness beat): family lore, fiction; Rizal never shown in close-up or face-on, only from behind (library, ship) or as hands; the datu in sentence 10 is a generic fictional figure seen from behind. The lamp appears only after the crowd has gone (sentence 47 on). The watcher is the Episode 8 dark-coat, wide-hat figure. No weapons. Unused spares in full/: m_unroll, usman_jump, star_medallion, m_eyes, map_lamp_dot, indio_lens_eye, indio_question, m_whisper_night, indio_ask, descend_rocks; chars indio_pocket, usman_galilee; plate galilee_hill.
